details: This package is an offensive-security "agent skills" toolkit that installs AI-agent instructions and ships a credential-harvesting script chain aimed at third-party web hosts. bin/install.js writes skill and prompt-injection files into ~/.pi/agent/skills/agent-bypass, ~/.config/opencode/skills/agent-bypass and ~/.agents/skills/agent-bypass, appends marker-delimited blocks to the global agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, APPEND_SYSTEM.md) and to ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml, and records what it wrote in.agent-bypass-manifest.json. scripts/keystrike.py takes target hosts discovered through the FOFA (hxxps://fofa[.]info/api/v1/search/all) and Shodan (hxxps://api[.]shodan[.]io/shodan/host/search) search APIs and requests roughly 80 credential paths against each target: /.env, /.env.backup, /.npmrc, /.git/HEAD, /.ssh/id_rsa, /.ssh/id_ed25519, /.claude/.credentials.json, /.codex/auth.json, /.opencode/auth.json, /.hermes/auth.json, /.hermes/config.yaml, /.openclaw/openclaw.json, /config.yaml, /.mcp.json, wallet.json, wallet.dat, mnemonic, private.key, binance.json, api_keys.json. It extracts vendor API keys from the responses (AWS, JWT, SMTP, MySQL, Redis, and provider key patterns), writes them to local result files, and validates harvested the model keys against hxxps://api[.]the model to confirm live balances. The bundled skill document ck-hunter.md drives the same hunt with FOFA/Shodan/Quake/Hunter queries against the.hermes,.claude,.codex,.openclaw,.opencode,.npmrc,.ssh,.env, TelegramDesktop, wallet.json, wallet.dat, binance.json,.ethereum, private.key and mnemonic paths. scripts/origin_trace.py resolves domains over DoH (hxxps://1[.]1[.]1[.]1/dns-query, hxxps://dns[.]google/resolve, hxxps://223[.]5[.]5[.]5/resolve), enumerates subdomains from crt.sh, api[.]certspotter[.]com, otx[.]alienvault[.]com, api[.]hackertarget[.]com, jldc[.]me and rapiddns[.]io, and then connects directly to candidate IPs on port 443 with certificate and hostname verification disabled (check_hostname=False, verify_mode=CERT_NONE) to fingerprint origin servers behind a CDN/WAF. The package contains no attacker-owned command-and-control or exfiltration endpoint and no install-time code execution: every outbound destination is one of the public search, certificate-transparency/passive-DNS or the model service APIs listed above, and collected data is written to local files (hunt/unique_hosts.txt, hunt_report.html) under the operator's working directory.
